scope: Roll-channel simulation feasibility; all frozen cohorts retained
statistics: Every seed reported separately; no iid episode confidence intervals
gate_definition: RMSE<=1.5 deg/s AND peak<=5 deg/s AND force TV<=12 N/s; divergence fails
finite_statistics: Failures stay in denominators; their undefined continuous metrics are null
initial_threshold_note: These cases fail the exact 5 deg/s gate by <=1e-5; raw metrics are preserved. Use recovery RMS and censored settling for initial-deviation conclusions, not this threshold count.
